name: Deep Industries Ltd
title: Deep Industries Ltd - 543288 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up 49% to INR248.7 crores and FY27 growth guided at 25-30%, but order book flat near INR3,000 crores for 4-5 quarters, a INR208 crore Kandla receivable write-off, and INR160 crore Dolphin receivables still held.

capex.quote: we are doing capex of around INR150 crores under PEC this year

triggers.label: FY26 capex plan ~INR300 crores
triggers.quote: for this year, we are targeting to have capex of around INR300 crores

triggers.label: INR208 crore receivable write-off
triggers.quote: the company has elected to write off these legacy trade receivables

triggers.label: Order book flat near INR3,000 crores
triggers.quote: our order book has stagnated at around this INR3,000 crore odd level for the past 4, 5 quarters

triggers.label: FY27 growth 25-30% guided
triggers.quote: we are expecting growth of around 25% to 30% year-on-year, so definitely

guidance.quote: we are expecting growth of around 25% to 30% year-on-year, so definitely
we should be able to maintain EBITDA of 44%, 45% year-on-year
we are expecting top line of around INR150 crores from this financial year and the current FY27 with EBITDA of almost 60%
we are targeting to have capex of around INR300 crores

red_flags.label: INR208 crore exceptional write-off of Kandla receivables
red_flags.quote: we have taken write-off of around INR208 crores of Kandla legacy trade receivables

red_flags.label: INR160 crore Dolphin legacy receivables still on books
red_flags.quote: out of total INR160 crores of Dolphin Group trade receivables, we have a good amount of arbitration award in our favor

red_flags.label: Dolphin Q4 ECL provision ~INR10 crore and margin squeeze
red_flags.quote: we had one, one -off item of ECL, which is expected credit loss provisioning of around INR10 crores

red_flags.label: Mori-5 stop production order, 5-6 month PEC delay
red_flags.quote: the incident has resulted into a 5 - to 6-month shift in our production enhancement time line

red_flags.label: Rig damaged, force majeure on workover contract
red_flags.quote: those matters are currently under active consideration, and they are going through the formalities

evasions.topic: Order book stagnation and timing of inflows
evasions.quote: maybe in some quarter or 2, you would see that numbers also coming quite above to what the current levels are
those matters are currently under active consideration, and they are going through the formalities
